Container.Name: Manager.io
Container.Overview: Unofficial community packaging of proprietary Manager.io Server Edition. A Manager Server licence is required for production use. Back up /data before upgrades. Prefer an exact version tag for accounting data.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Host port; change to 8280 if 8080 is occupied. Keep container port 8080.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent Manager data. Back up before upgrading.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Runtime numeric UID; 99 is common on Unraid.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Runtime numeric GID; 100 is common on Unraid.

Config.Name: File creation mask
Config.Description: 0027 restricts access to owner/group. Use 0002 only if group write access is intended.
